title: PropertyOps® B2B lead-generation website with operational positioning and consultation request intake

requirements.text: Create a single-page marketing website homepage for PropertyOps® with the exact section structure and user-facing copy direction provided: Hero (headline, subheadline, CTA), How It Works (3 steps), Technology & Systems (ops-supporting tech, explicitly not replacing people), Services (exactly three services), Quality Control, Contractor Model, Trust/Differentiators callouts, and Franchise Teaser.

quotes:
Homepage Structure & Copy Direction
Hero Section

Headline:
Standardized Property Operations. Done Right.

Subheadline:
PropertyOps delivers consistent, documented property services through systemized workflows, digital checklists, and vetted local contractors.

CTA:

acceptanceCriteria: Homepage renders all required sections in the specified order.
Hero section includes the exact headline text: “Standardized Property Operations. Done Right.”
Hero section includes the provided subheadline and a primary CTA labeled “Request a Service Consultation”.
How It Works section presents exactly three steps with the provided titles and supporting text.

Technology & Systems section includes the exact headline “Technology That Supports Operations — Not Replaces People” and clearly states systems support a U.S.-based operations team and do not replace human decision-making or labor.
Services section contains exactly these three services (no more, no less): Rental Turnover Condition Reports; Minor Turnover Repairs & Punch Lists; Exterior Maintenance Packages.
Quality Control, Contractor Model, Trust callouts, and Franchise teaser sections are present and reflect the provided content direction without “startup hype” or “AI/futuristic” language.

requirements.text: Implement a lead-capture workflow for the “Request a Service Consultation” CTA that opens a consultation request form (embedded section or modal) and submits the request to the backend for storage, with a clear success state and basic client-side validation.

quotes:
Primary Goal:
Generate inbound leads from property managers, landlords, and real estate operators

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking “Request a Service Consultation” reveals a form without leaving the site flow (modal or in-page).
Form includes, at minimum: name, email, phone (optional), company/portfolio (optional), city/state (optional), request details/message, and a consent/acknowledgement checkbox.
Client-side validation prevents submission when required fields are missing and shows user-friendly inline errors.
On successful submission, the UI shows a confirmation message and clears/locks the form to prevent duplicate accidental resubmits.
Backend persists submitted consultation requests with timestamp and unique ID and exposes a query method suitable for an internal admin view later (even if the admin UI is not built now).

requirements.text: Apply a cohesive visual theme that matches the provided design direction: clean, modern, professional; neutral palette (dark blue, slate, white) with subtle green accents; use icons for SOPs/checklists/documentation/QC and process/flow visuals; avoid robots, “AI brain” imagery, and flashy/futuristic visuals.

quotes:
Visual & Design Direction

Clean, modern, professional

Neutral colors (dark blue, slate, white, subtle green accents)

Icons for SOPs, checklists, documentation, QC

No “AI brain,” robots, or futuristic imagery

Use diagrams, flow visuals, and process graphics instead

acceptanceCriteria: Site styling consistently uses a neutral palette dominated by dark blue/slate/white with subtle green accents.
Icons are used in relevant sections (e.g., SOPs/checklists/documentation/QC) and do not include robotic/futuristic motifs.
At least one process/flow visual (diagram-like) is used to reinforce the operational workflow presentation.
Typography, spacing, and layout read as “professional/operational” (not playful, neon, or highly stylized).

requirements.text: Add SEO fundamentals for a B2B services homepage: page title, meta description, semantic headings, and on-page keyword placement emphasizing the provided SEO keywords, while keeping the tone calm and operational (no hype/buzzwords).

acceptanceCriteria: Homepage includes an appropriate HTML document title and meta description aligned with PropertyOps® and the operational positioning.
Sections use semantic headings (H1 for hero, H2 for major sections).
Copy naturally incorporates the provided SEO keyword phrases (or close grammatical variants) without keyword stuffing.
No copy introduces “AI hype” phrasing or flashy tech claims.

requirements.text: Include credibility-forward, compliance-friendly messaging consistent with the brief (U.S.-based operations team, documented delivery, standardized processes) suitable for investors, franchise prospects, and immigration authorities, without adding legal claims or guarantees.

quotes:
Primary Goal:
... establishing credibility with investors, franchise prospects, and immigration authorities (E-2 visa compliant).

Technology & Systems Section (VERY IMPORTANT)
...
These systems assist our U.S.-based operations team...
Technology enhances efficiency and reliability but does not replace human decision-making or labor.

acceptanceCriteria: Technology section explicitly states operations are supported by internal systems and managed by a U.S.-based operations team.
Website emphasizes standardized workflows, digital checklists, and photo documentation as part of documented delivery.
Copy avoids legal/immigration guarantees (e.g., does not claim approval outcomes) while remaining credibility-focused.

requirements.text: Render generated brand visuals (icons/diagram/hero graphic) as static frontend assets and use them in the appropriate sections (hero, how-it-works, quality control, trust callouts), without routing image delivery through the backend.

quotes: Icons for SOPs, checklists, documentation, QC
Use diagrams, flow visuals, and process graphics instead

acceptanceCriteria: All generated images are placed under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced directly by the frontend.
Icons appear in at least: How It Works, Technology & Systems, Quality Control, and Trust/Differentiators sections.
At least one diagram/flow graphic is displayed in the How It Works section (or adjacent) to visualize the 3-step process.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Do not edit immutable hook/bootstrap files: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
nonGoals: Do not implement third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is allowed; not required for this build).
Do not integrate external CRMs, email/SMS providers, or marketing automation (store leads on-canister only).
Do not add real-time chat, push notifications, or websockets.
Do not add payments or subscription checkout.

required: Clean 3-step process flow diagram illustration in dark blue/slate with subtle green accents, white background (diagram-how-it-works.dim_1600x900.png)
Abstract operational grid/blueprint-style hero background (no futuristic AI/robots), dark blue/slate with subtle green accent lines (hero-bg.dim_2400x1200.png)

preferencesToAdd: Use English for all user-facing website copy.
Prefer a clean, modern, professional visual style with dark blue/slate/white and subtle green accents; avoid AI/robot/futuristic imagery.
miscToAdd: Brand: PropertyOps®; positioning: technology-enabled, standardized documented property services delivered via vetted independent contractors + centralized U.S.-based operations team; tone: calm, operational, no hype.
